parts.label: (a)
parts.text:

If no reaction occurs, write 'no reaction'.

| 2,4-DNPH | no reaction |  |  |  |
| acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7\text{(aq)}$ | no reaction |  |  |  |

parts.text:
**Q** is reduced by $\text{NaBH}_4$.

Write an equation for the reaction of **Q** with $\text{NaBH}_4$.

In your answer, use $[\text{H}]$ to represent $\text{NaBH}_4$.

The infra-red spectrum shown corresponds to one of **P**, **Q** or **R**.

{{figure:visual_auto_03.png}}

Deduce which of the compounds, **P**, **Q** or **R**, produces this spectrum. Explain your reasoning.

In your answer, identify any relevant absorptions in the infra-red spectrum and the bonds that correspond to these absorptions in the region **above** $1500\text{ cm}^{-1}$.
